create_splits_json: run the script to create a splits.json file from image files split by camera ID
create_train_test_split: create a train and test split JSON from HDR image files using camera ID prefixes
create_split_with_extension: create a splits.json file from image files with a custom extension like png or jpg
create_split_custom_output: create a splits.json file and save it to a custom output filename
create_split_from_images_dir: create a train/test split JSON from an images directory using comma-separated test camera IDs
